title: Grader accuracy check
intro: Runs the AI grader on answers that people already labelled, and measures how often it agrees with them. Each answer costs a few model calls (one per vote, a repeat and two reworded prompts).
notJudged: This benchmark is graded by automatic checks, not by an AI grader, so there is nothing to check here. To use an AI grader, set grading: judged and pick a judge model in the benchmark file.
noLabels: Add at least one labelled answer below (or add the expected and wrong answers) before running the check.
seedControls: Also add the benchmark's expected and wrong answers as weak example labels
sampleHint: People's labels come first. 0 checks all {{count}} labelled answer(s).
hostedCap: Hosted cap: {{calls}} calls and ${{usd}} per run, paid with your org's own key.
noKey: Your organisation has no working {{provider}} key. The hosted check only uses your own key.
confirm: This calls the grader model about {{calls}} time(s), billed to your key. Run it?
